articles.title: “Dragged for 300 Metres”: Speeding Thar Mows Down Bikers in Rampur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A horrific road accident was reported in the Rampur city police station area, where a speeding Thar SUV allegedly hit two youth on a motorcycle and dragged them for nearly 300 metres, leaving them critically injured.

body.html:
A horrific road accident was reported in the Rampur city police station area, where a speeding Thar SUV allegedly hit two youth on a motorcycle and dragged them for nearly 300 metres, leaving them critically injured.

The incident occurred on the intervening night of Thursday (19 March) and Friday (20 March) (not exact date available). According to locals, the speeding Thar rammed into the bike and continued moving, dragging both riders along the road.

The injured were identified as Arshaan and Farman. Both were rushed to the district hospital.

Doctors declared Arshaan’s condition critical and referred him to a higher medical centre in Moradabad. Reports indicate that both his legs were severely damaged and fractured. Farman sustained serious injuries to his head, arms, and legs and is currently undergoing treatment.

Anurag Singh, Additional Superintendent of Police, confirmed that a case has been registered against the accused driver, Muaz Khan, a resident of Jumma Colony. Police teams are actively searching for him.

Locals alleged that the vehicle belongs to the son of a municipal councillor and have demanded strict action against rash driving. The incident has intensified concerns over speeding vehicles in the area.

Police have assured that the investigation will be conducted impartially and necessary action will be taken.

#RoadAccident #Ranmpur #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh #HitAndRun

articles.title: “Stray Bull Attack Caught on Camera”: Elderly Man Injured, Animal Captured in Firozabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A stray bull attack in Sirsaganj town of Uttar Pradesh’s Firozabad district left an elderly man injured, with the incident triggering concern among locals.

body.html:
A stray bull attack in Sirsaganj town of Uttar Pradesh’s Firozabad district left an elderly man injured, with the incident triggering concern among locals.

The incident took place around 5:30 PM on Friday when 65-year-old Vishnu Diwakar, a resident of Gajadhar Gali, was passing through the busy market area. A stray bull suddenly attacked him, tossing him into the air and throwing him onto the road.

He sustained injuries in the attack and was assisted by locals. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

After the video surfaced on social media, the municipal authorities took swift action. A special team was deployed on Saturday to capture the bull.

According to chairman representative Gurudutt Singh, the animal was safely caught and sent to a cowshed to prevent further incidents.

The action has brought relief to traders and residents in the market area, who had expressed concern following the attack.

Local residents said the incident could have happened to anyone and welcomed the municipality’s move, calling it a necessary step to ensure public safety.

#Firozabad #StrayCattle #PublicSafety #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh

articles.title: “Snatched in Seconds”: Phone Robbery Caught on CCTV, Accused Still at Large in Lucknow
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A mobile snatching incident in Lucknow’s Sainik Nagar (Telibagh) area has raised safety concerns after the accuse remained untraced even three days after the crime.

body.html:
A mobile snatching incident in Lucknow’s Sainik Nagar (Telibagh) area has raised safety concerns after the accuse remained untraced even three days after the crime.

According to the complaint, Poonam Tiwari, a resident of Kailashpuri, was heading to her sister’s house on Tuesday evening when the incident occurred. As she reached near a Ganesh Temple in Street No. 1, a youth on a bike snatched her mobile phone and fled.

Despite chasing the accuse, he managed to escape towards Street No. 12.

The entire incident was captured on nearby CCTV cameras. Police reached the spot soon after receiving information and seized the footage. An investigation has been launched based on the visuals

However, even after three days, police have not been able to trace or arrest the accused, leading to tension among residents.

Gajendra Joshi, president of the Sainik Nagar Residential Welfare Committee, expressed concern over the delay and said the incident has created panic in the area. He urged police to take swift action to ensure safety.

Further investigation is underway.

#Lucknow #Snatching #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh

articles.title: “Bribe for Justice?”: Woman SI, Driver Suspended in Kidnapping Probe Corruption Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major action in Uttar Pradesh, the Superintendent of Police in Kaimganj has suspended a woman sub-inspector and her constable driver after a video allegedly showing them accepting a bribe went viral.

body.html:
In a major action in Uttar Pradesh, the Superintendent of Police in Kaimganj has suspended a woman sub-inspector and her constable driver after a video allegedly showing them accepting a bribe went viral.

According to reports, the case relates to a complaint filed by a family alleging the kidnapping of their 14 year-old niece by influential individuals in their village. An FIR had already been registered at the local police station.

The family accused Sub-Inspector Sudha Pal, who was handling the investigation, of demanding ₹25,000 for conducting a “fair probe.” Under pressure, the victim’s family allegedly paid ₹7,000, a video of which later surfaced on social media.

The family further alleged that even after paying the bribe, the accused persons continued to roam freely and allegedly threatened them. They also claimed the accused boasted of having influence over the investigating officer, raising serious concerns about police integrity.

Taking cognisance of the viral video and complaint, SP Aarti Singh ordered the suspension of the sub-inspector and the constable driver.

Additional SP Arun Kumar Singh confirmed that a departmental inquiry has been initiated and handed over to the Circle Officer of Mohammadabad. Further legal action will depend on the findings of the probe.

Following the incident, four sub-inspectors—Gyan Prakash Pandey, Ankur Bhati, Ramnaresh Singh, and Ashok Kumar—have been deployed from Police Lines to Kaimganj Police Station.

The investigation is ongoing.

#UttarPradesh #PoliceCorruption #BreakingNews #Kaimganj #LawAndOrder

articles.title: “Gas Cylinder Dispute Turns Missing Case”: Woman Leaves Home With Infant in Barabanki
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A domestic dispute over a gas cylinder has turned into a missing person case in Uttar Pradesh’s Barabanki district, after a woman left her home with her five-month-old child. The incident took place in Baudhni hamlet under Ghungheter police station limits.

body.html:
A domestic dispute over a gas cylinder has turned into a missing person case in Uttar Pradesh’s Barabanki district, after a woman left her home with her five-month-old child.

The incident took place in Baudhni hamlet under Ghungheter police station limits. According to the complaint, Anil Kumar, who works at a power company, returned home after night duty on Monday morning and found that no food had been prepared.

When he questioned his wife, Suman Devi (29), she reportedly refused to cook on a traditional earthen stove and insisted that the LPG cylinder be refilled. The disagreement soon escalated into an argument.

Anil said he went to rest after the dispute. When he woke up around 4 PM, he found that his wife had left the house with their five-month-old son. She had also taken some clothes and ₹1,000 in cash.

The husband and his family searched for her at multiple relatives’ homes across nearby areas, including Tedhawan, Asginagar, Usmanpur, and parts of Sitapur district, but found no trace of her.

Following the complaint, police have registered a missing person report and initiated an investigation.

Station House Officer Bechu Yadav confirmed that further legal action is underway based on the written complaint.

Meanwhile, the husband has appealed to his wife to return home, stating that any mistakes can be resolved.

#Barabanki #MissingCase #UttarPradesh #DomesticDispute

articles.title: “Shot Inside Campus”: Varanasi College Student Killed in Broad Daylight
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident unfolded at Uday Pratap College in Varanasi, where an undergraduate student was allegedly shot dead by two fellow students inside the campus on Friday. According to police sources, the incident took place around noon in the presence of hundreds of students and staff.

body.html:
A shocking incident unfolded at Uday Pratap College in Varanasi, where an undergraduate student was allegedly shot dead by two fellow students inside the campus on Friday.

According to police sources, the incident took place around noon in the presence of hundreds of students and staff. The victim, Surya Pratap Singh, a B.Sc fourth semester student from Ghazipur, was standing in a queue to submit his assignment near the social science department.

Eyewitnesses said two students, identified as Manjit Chauhan and Anuj Singh, approached him and got into a heated argument.

Shortly after the altercation, one of the accused allegedly pulled out a pistol and opened fire. Surya Pratap sustained critical injuries and collapsed on the spot. He was rushed to a hospital but later succumbed to his injuries.

The accused fled the scene immediately after the shooting.

Following the incident, angry students created chaos on campus, vandalised property, and raised slogans against the college administration, demanding immediate arrests. Nearby shops were also forced to shut down amid the tension.

Police suspect old enmity as the motive behind the killing. A manhunt has been launched to arrest the accused, and heavy security has been deployed on the campus to maintain law and order.

Further investigation is underway.

#Varanasi #CampusCrime #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh #StudentViolence

articles.title: “Blue Drum Fear”: Bulandshahr Man Lets Wife Leave After Alleged Murder Threat Clues
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre and disturbing case has emerged from Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr, where a man claimed he chose to separate from his wife after allegedly discovering messages that made him fear for his life.

body.html:
A bizarre and disturbing case has emerged from Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr, where a man claimed he chose to separate from his wife after allegedly discovering messages that made him fear for his life.

According to Rajkumar, his wife had been in a relationship with another man and frequently argued with him before leaving their home. He alleged that she had been living with her lover while staying at her parents’ house.

The situation escalated when Rajkumar checked his wife’s phone during a call. He claimed to have found objectionable photos and social media posts referencing “cement aur drum” and “blue drum,” along with an image of himself paired with similar captions.

Rajkumar interpreted these messages as a possible threat to his life. He further alleged that during arguments, his wife had threatened to kill him and even harm his family members.

He also claimed that she neglected household responsibilities and expressed a clear intention to live with her partner.

Following the developments, Rajkumar approached the police. During mediation, his wife reportedly stated that she wanted to live with her lover.

Fearing for his safety, Rajkumar said he decided to part ways and allowed her to leave.

Police have taken note of the complaint and are examining the matter. Further inquiry is underway to verify the claims and assess any potential threat.

#Bulandshahr #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #DomesticDispute #BreakingNews #IndiaNews

articles.title: “Chain Collision Horror”: 8 Killed, Including Infant, in Salem Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A devastating road accident in Tamil Nadu’s Salem district has claimed eight lives, including an 11-month-old infant, after a bus collided with a mini-van and a motorcycle.

body.html:
A devastating road accident in Tamil Nadu’s Salem district has claimed eight lives, including an 11-month-old infant, after a bus collided with a mini-van and a motorcycle.

Multiple Vehicles Involved

The accident occurred near Ariyanur when a Tamil Nadu RTC bus travelling from Coimbatore to Salem allegedly lost control due to high speed and rammed into a mini-van (tempo). A motorcycle following the vehicles also crashed in the aftermath.

The bus reportedly veered off the road after the collision, intensifying the impact.

Heavy Casualties

Eight people died on the spot, including the infant and several members of the same family. Among the victims were a mother and daughter travelling on the motorcycle. Five of the deceased reportedly belonged to one family.

Six others sustained serious injuries and were rushed to nearby hospitals after locals alerted authorities.

Investigation Underway

Preliminary findings point to overspeeding by the bus as the likely cause of the accident. Police have taken the bus driver into custody and are examining CCTV footage from the area to determine the exact sequence of events.

The tragedy has left the region in deep shock and mourning.

#Salem #RoadAccident #TamilNadu #BreakingNews #AccidentNews #PublicSafety #IndiaNews

articles.title: “Burqa Disguise Theft Busted”: Father-Son Duo Steal ₹80 Lakh Electronics in Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru police have cracked a high-value theft case, arresting a father-son duo for stealing computer components worth around ₹80 lakh from an electronics shop in the city. The incident came to light after a shop owner in Nagawara found his store broken into on March 14.

body.html:
Bengaluru police have cracked a high-value theft case, arresting a father-son duo for stealing computer components worth around ₹80 lakh from an electronics shop in the city.

The incident came to light after a shop owner in Nagawara found his store broken into on March 14. The store, which had been locked the previous night, had its shutter damaged and valuables missing.

Stolen items included 444 DDR4 RAM units, 279 SSDs, and ₹2.4 lakh in cash.

CCTV footage revealed that the accused carried out the theft while wearing burqas, making initial identification difficult. Police then analysed footage from surrounding areas to trace their movements.

Arrest and Motive:
The Govindapura police arrested one accused near a hotel in Nagawara and later apprehended his father based on interrogation. The accused were identified as Hemanth and his father Manjunath.

Police said Hemanth was a former employee of the shop and had allegedly planned the theft following a salary dispute with the owner.

Recovery of Stolen Goods:
All stolen items, including electronic components and cash, were recovered from a location in T Channayya Layout. The two-wheeler used in the crime was also seized.

Further investigation is underway.

#Bengaluru #TheftCase #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #PoliceAction #Robbery #IndiaNews

articles.title: “Bribe in a Diary?”: Agra Cop Suspended After CCTV Clip Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A CCTV video allegedly showing a police officer accepting a bribe hidden inside a diary has surfaced from Achhnera police station in Uttar Pradesh’s Agra, triggering swift action from authorities. The accused, SSI Jitendra Yadav, has been suspended following the viral video.

body.html:
A CCTV video allegedly showing a police officer accepting a bribe hidden inside a diary has surfaced from Achhnera police station in Uttar Pradesh’s Agra, triggering swift action from authorities.

The accused, SSI Jitendra Yadav, has been suspended following the viral video. DCP West Aditya Singh has ordered a detailed inquiry into the incident.

Caught on Camera:
In the footage, the officer is seen seated inside the police station while a few individuals sit across from him. During the interaction, he hands over a diary to one of them. The man appears to place something inside it before returning it.

The officer is then seen taking out an item from the diary and putting it into his pocket, raising allegations of bribery.

Probe Ordered:
Police officials have initiated an investigation to identify the individuals involved and determine the case in connection with which the alleged bribe was taken. The amount exchanged is yet to be confirmed.

DCP West has also sought a report from the concerned ACP regarding the matter.

Questions Over Leak:
The viral clip has also raised questions about how CCTV footage from inside a police station was accessed and circulated on social media.

Authorities said further action will be taken based on the findings of the inquiry.

#Agra #Corruption #PoliceScandal #BreakingNews #CCTV
